model.note: Largest Kokoro v1.0 ONNX build (FP32 ~310MB). Official package size is 82M params; FP32 is the highest-precision ONNX export.

Narrator.rationale: Default Michael (US male). Clear narrative baseline for outline prose.

Zao.rationale: Mature natural female (HH training). Closest dry/functional contralto among high-data EN voices; Mandarin inflection not available in EN Kokoro presets.

Voss.rationale: Mature authoritative male. Matches baritone command presence and disciplined formal English.

Harlan.rationale: British polished officer timbre; cooler/businesslike vs Voss’s warmer authority.

Elin.rationale: Younger expressive female; lighter than Zao. Indian inflection not available in EN presets.

Sorell.rationale: Warm expressive mezzo with strong training data. French-accent EN not available; ff_siwis is French-language-only.

Okoye.rationale: Firm high-grade female presence for security commands. Nigerian inflection not available in EN presets.

Cael.rationale: Bright clear high voice for informal pilot/comms energy.
